clan.description: ⚔️JOIN US! - APPLY NOW ⚔️We are a friendly, competitive Guild. Lots of help and guidance is always available. Are you a fighter? Like GBG and QI? Then apply to join. Ascent recently welcomed players from both Silver Swords and Apella. Silver Swords is our sister Guild for players who enjoy a more relaxed pace in which to grow and play the game. Lots of help with your GBs - we have very active 2.0, MAX and 1.9 GB boost threads. Diamond GbG and QI are our main focus. We also aim to finish L80 on GE5 most weeks.——GE 1-5 - all levels open each week.GbG & QI -  active participation is expected.Guild 1.9 and MAX boost threadsMessages - please respond to all messages.Trades - fair trades are expected. Unfair trades can be agreed between guild members.APPLY NOW!
